free_tier.stated: no free allowance: builds.sr.ht requires a paid account (EUR 4 or USD 4 a month at the lowest tier, every tier with the same service and limits) for users registered on or after 2021-05-01; free service is issued to a user who emails support explaining that they cannot pay

per_object_cap.stated: 1 GiB per artifact file; the hosted build time limit is not published, the documented SSH message reads 'Your VM will be terminated 4 hours from now', and the software's example configuration sets a 45-minute maximum build duration

retention.stated: artifacts are uploaded only for successful jobs and pruned after 90 days

egress.terms: unverified: no egress terms were found in the pages read

interface_detail: a YAML build manifest submitted through the API, the web form at builds.sr.ht/submit, a manifest in a git.sr.ht or hg.sr.ht repository, patches sent to a mailing list, or the hut CLI; SSH into a running or failed build VM
tooling: full virtual machines with root through sudo, on x86_64 images (the only native architecture in the image table); the hut CLI. SourceHut is AGPL-3.0 software the user can install and run on a rented or free machine, which comes after the hosted service
chaining: a paid or aid-granted account gets full VMs with root and SSH access; artifacts leave through the jobs page and are pruned at 90 days

limits.value: submitting build jobs needs a paid account; free service only after an emailed request to support
artifacts pruned after 90 days, uploaded only for successful jobs

limits_note: the hosted runner size and per-user concurrency are not published; the build image control script boots each VM with 2 CPUs and 4096 MB of memory unless configured otherwise, and a build host of 16 cores and 128 GB supports up to 16 parallel build slots; a failed build's VM stays up 10 more minutes for SSH
binding_note: nothing runs without a payment or an aid grant; once paid, every tier has the same service limits

identity_cost.detail: a meta.sr.ht account registered as a maintainer with payment by credit card, SEPA direct debit, iDEAL or Bancontact; free service is issued on an emailed request to support; a contributor account without payment cannot submit builds

reliability_note: the service is in public alpha; from the beta, unpaid accounts become read-only for their own projects, with at least 60 days notice by email; pricing is set to change after the alpha
confidence_note: the pricing, billing FAQ, builds billing-change, alpha, builds and manifest pages were read and quoted on 2026-10-30; runner size and the 45-minute timeout come from the open-source repository's defaults, not from the hosted service, and no build was run.
